aiEngines.savedQueued: AI engine settings saved (waiting to reach measurement)

state.partial: Only part of the measurements served

fix.unlinked: The project is not linked to the measurement engine yet. Press 'Save + run' on the Prompt tab to request the link.
fix.pending_link: The link request is queued. Refresh in a moment to check the state.
fix.link_error: The link request stopped with an error. Check the error count in the sync queue and tell an operator.
fix.no_data: The link works but no servable measurement exists yet. Check whether measurement ran and the latest round.
fix.partial: Only part of the measurement jobs are served. Check the failed and in-progress counts.
fix.healthy: The setup is healthy. If an analysis screen looks empty, check the filters and whether the latest round is published.
